source.check: returned unopposed: named in column 6 ('Names of Candidates Elected') with no votes in column 5 in the Returning Officer's notice of result (Lisburn Standard, 6 June 1952, p. 1; read on the BNA page image)

note: Triennial election of the district electoral divisions of Hillsborough rural district, one member each, polled on 5 June 1952. Only Carryduff was contested; two new members were returned unopposed. The other thirteen divisions are recorded from the Returning Officer's notice of result (Lisburn Standard, 6 June 1952, p. 1), which also confirms the Carryduff poll (Booth 352, Carlisle 250) and the Anahilt and Edenderry returns; Drumbo's retiring member was deemed re-elected (meetings pass, 7 Nov 2026). Returned unopposed.
